objective: Move the trusted-cookie teacher auth issuer proof from a generation-side TTL convention to an enforced validation-side security boundary.

changes.summary: Rejects validly signed trusted issuer claims when issuedAt is invalid or in the future, expiresAt is not after issuedAt, or proof lifetime exceeds 300 seconds.
Adds redacted issuerProofValidation evidence covering max lifetime, future issuedAt rejection, invalid time-order rejection, and overlong lifetime rejection.
Requires issuerProofValidation to be proved before trusted-cookie route-chain evidence can satisfy teacher-auth provider readiness.
Surfaces and requires issuerProofValidation in both direct trusted route-chain and nested teacher-auth provider readiness evidence.
